observed_condition: An initial read-only inventory used GNU find -printf syntax that is unavailable in the host find implementation, so it returned no usable file inventory and changed no artifact.
corrective_action: Repeat the inventory with repository-relative rg --files selectors, which are portable in this governed environment.

observed_condition: A read-only progress inspection used two wildcard arguments before any matching Checkpoint 012 files existed; zsh rejected both unmatched globs before the intended ls commands ran and no artifact changed.
corrective_action: Use find with exact -name patterns or rg --files for progress inspection; repeat after the agent-created paths exist.

observed_condition: The first primary build rejected one manually transcribed pinned hash for the committed isolated-active-term ledger before it emitted an authoritative final artifact set.
corrective_action: Recompute the exact file SHA-256 from committed Checkpoint 011 bytes, correct only that literal, and rerun the complete build and byte check.

observed_condition: The first independent run exposed intentionally different activation and product-eligibility field names between hypothesis shards 1 and 2; the verifier rejected a shared-field assumption.
corrective_action: Normalize each shard's governed schema independently, require exact allowed inactive statuses and false product eligibility, and rerun all source-set and adversarial checks.

observed_condition: A subsequent independent run attempted to read shard-1-only payload_retained from the shard-2 rights ledger even though the value was unused in the governed rights supersession join.
corrective_action: Remove the unused cross-shard field assumption; retain exact source identity, normalized identifier, rights-record, and fail-closed review semantics; rerun verification.

observed_condition: The final hardening review found that case folding alone would not make equivalent DOI, doi:, doi.org, dx.doi.org, HTTP, and HTTPS representations compare identically under adversarial formatting.
corrective_action: Implement resolver-prefix normalization separately in primary and independent code; require positive normalization controls and retain the DOI-only rights-join negative control.

observed_condition: The first v3 semantic independent check reproduced all 798 substantive checks but found that its verifier-owned receipt still described the Checkpoint 011 additive database files as untracked rather than committed additions relative to the semantic-contract parent.
corrective_action: Regenerate only the deterministic verifier-owned receipt after the additive checkpoint commit, then rerun check mode and require byte identity.

observed_condition: The first Round 16A reconciliation primary and independent checks stopped before enumeration because their input contract still pinned the pre-Checkpoint-011 .gitattributes hash 39220b2b34b02184bc84ff293163c874819305b6cbf1005faac573d5bab48098 rather than the committed hash 986c47b85349d7589c537507c53ca768a53b7fac1059fd0a434b2366f9e2b65b that adds only audit-log whitespace rules.
corrective_action: Bump both reconciliation program versions, pin the committed .gitattributes bytes in both implementations, regenerate the primary manifest and derivative receipts, then independently reconstruct and byte-check the full reconciliation without changing protected v2 artifacts.

observed_condition: The first recursive-gap implementation treated all 12 committed rights-ledger rows as completed text review. This incorrectly resolved the canonical rights obligations for abstract-only or full-text-open COMP-SRC-017 and COMP-SRC-023 and incorrectly superseded the COMP-SRC-017 metadata lead, yielding misleading residuals of 83 and 99.
corrective_action: Derive completion independently from concrete access, text-review, locator, and rights-disposition fields; retain abstract-only and explicitly open full-text records as obligations; regenerate all seven artifacts and the report. The conservative residuals are 85 rights identities and 100 metadata leads.

observed_condition: The first independent verifier proved physical membership and aggregate disposition counts but did not prove every GAP row's exact disposition and successor set or every current obligation's exact class, count semantics, member kind, evidence paths, required action, and closure blockers.
corrective_action: Add independently maintained 105-row GAP routing and 16-row obligation semantic contracts, reject aggregate-preserving route swaps and wrong action or blocker mutations, and rerun the full independent verifier without importing the primary builder.

observed_condition: The first supersession builder projected all 94 canonical rights rows as UNSPECIFIED because generic prior-status selection omitted rights, text-access, and locator fields; the first independent input-manifest verifier also omitted the authority_boundary column from its exact contract.
corrective_action: Project deterministic canonical rights/text/locator status for every baseline row, require zero UNSPECIFIED rights statuses, and independently verify every input authority boundary.

observed_condition: A read-only git status after deterministic reconciliation hydration caused the Git LFS clean filter to request its repository temp area, which the initial filesystem sandbox denied; status aborted without changing tracked content, index, or refs.
corrective_action: Rerun the identical read-only status with narrowly escalated repository access so Git LFS could use its own temp area; verify the expected tracked and untracked checkpoint files only.

observed_condition: One read-only diagnostic tool cell referenced a JavaScript workdir variable from a prior isolate; the cell failed before invoking its intended repository command and changed no file or state.
corrective_action: Repeat the command with the absolute worktree path declared in the current isolate.

observed_condition: The first final v3 runtime primary and independent checks rejected the committed runtime manifest because it still bound the pre-correction Round 16A reconciliation census; the runtime read-model semantics and SHA remained unchanged.
corrective_action: Regenerate the manifest and checksum ledger from the corrected Round 16A census, require the read-model SHA to remain f1ae8a35895b27c15fb3d9b42828b8611633ee8ee7e2cbc825772b590304351b, then independently verify the refreshed bindings.

observed_condition: After the primary runtime manifest was correctly regenerated, the first independent write failed closed on its frozen old manifest trust anchor before emitting a receipt.
corrective_action: Review the exact manifest-only dependency change, advance the independent verifier to v4 with the new manifest and checksum hashes together, rerun 15 checks and 84 corruptions, and bind the resulting receipt into the recursive-gap input manifest.

observed_condition: The first API regression after runtime-manifest refresh rejected the new manifest hash because the TypeScript loader, API test, and production HTTP verifier still carried the reviewed Checkpoint 011 manifest and checksum pins.
corrective_action: Advance all three runtime consumers to the jointly reviewed manifest and checksum hashes, then rerun API tests, runtime typecheck, Python compilation, production build, and HTTP artifact validation.

observed_condition: The first production build compiled until next/font attempted to fetch IBM Plex Sans and Mono from fonts.googleapis.com; sandbox DNS returned ENOTFOUND and the governed build failed without changing source artifacts.
corrective_action: Rerun the same logged build with narrowly approved network access; require compilation, type validation, static generation, and build-trace collection to pass.

observed_condition: The first logged staging attempt could not create the isolated worktree Git index lock under the sandbox policy and exited before changing the index, tracked content, refs, or remotes.
corrective_action: Rerun the same narrowly scoped staging command with repository-metadata access, then verify the staged checkpoint surface with repository hygiene and new-blob policy checks.

observed_condition: The staged whitespace gate first identified CRLF record terminators and then the empty terminal error field's trailing tab in the generated HTTP case TSV, even though the artifact verification itself passed.
corrective_action: Set the self-contained HTTP verifier's TSV writer to an explicit LF terminator and serialize a successful empty error as the explicit NONE sentinel; regenerate the three bound artifact-check files, rerun artifact verification and Python compilation, and require a clean staged whitespace check.

observed_condition: One read-only inspection command used a misspelled isolated-worktree path and failed before process creation, changing no repository file, index, ref, or remote.
corrective_action: Repeat the same receipt and source inspection from the exact isolated-worktree path.
